steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: No idea. If he could find this place, he was probably also a hitman on the dark web.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: He mentioned your name. Is he your enemy?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Too many people want me dead, I can't remember every face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So people often come looking for trouble like this?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: This is the first time someone has found my hideout. Probably because I brought you here. It was quite a mess that day.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: It's not so safe here anymore. Don't wander around when I'm not here, be careful on your own.
